records.assay: DiscoveRx KINOMEscan Kd ELECT competitive binding; duplicate 11-point concentration-response curves
records.disposition: Internal primary-source discrepancy: prose and Table 1 interchange PDGFRA/PDGFRB Kd values. Qualitative target engagement supported, exact numerical calibration withheld.
records.citation: Heinrich MC et al. Clin Cancer Res. 2012;18:4375-4384.

records.assay: VEGF-C-stimulated PAE cells expressing VEGFR3 or VEGFR2, assessed by receptor immunoprecipitation and phosphotyrosine immunoblot
records.result: Strong suppression of VEGFR3 activation with little or no effect on VEGFR2 at 5 micromolar; at 50 micromolar inhibition was not receptor-selective.
records.disposition: Mechanistic nonclinical comparator; tested concentration is not an IC50. Authors caution that other RTKs may be inhibited.
records.citation: Kirkin V et al. Eur J Biochem. 2001;268:5530-5540.

records.result: MAZ51 affected some tumor cells that did not express VEGFR3, showing that a phenotype cannot automatically be attributed to FLT4 inhibition.
records.citation: Kirkin V et al. Int J Cancer. 2004;112:986-993.
